title: Effect on Osteoclast Differentiation and ER Stress Downregulation by Amygdalin and RANKL Binding Interaction.
authors: Trang, Nguyen Minh; Kim, Eun-Nam; Lee, Hyun-Su; Jeong, Gil-Saeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦杏仁苷与RANKL的分子对接及其对破骨细胞分化的抑制作用，虽含蛋白-配体对接，但对象为RANKL-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: Bone diseases such as osteoporosis are the result of osteoclast over-activation. There are many therapeutic agents from natural compounds inhibiting the formation of osteoclast that have been reported and are continuously being interested. Amygdalin (AD) is isolated from seeds of Prunus armeniaca L. which has many pharmaceutical effects; however, the effect of AD on osteoclast formation and function remains unknown. Therefore, the underlying mechanism of AD on RANKL-induced osteoclast in RAW 264.7 cells was investigated. Molecular docking simulation revealed that AD can bind to the active sites of RANKL with negative binding affinities. Through TRAP activity, bone resorption, and migration, AD effectively inhibited osteoclast differentiation and function. Expression of transcription factors, such as NFATc1, c-fos, and osteospecific genes (including dcstamp, acp5, ATP6v0d2, and ctsk results) showed an osteoclast differentiated inhibitory effect by AD treatment. In addition, RANKL-induced activation of MAPK, ER stress, and ROS levels in RANKL-induced osteoclast was significantly inhibited while antioxidant enzymes were recovered in the presence of AD. These results suggest that AD may be a potential candidate derived from natural sources for the treatment of osteoclast bone-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 骨病如骨质疏松症是破骨细胞过度活化的结果。已有许多来自天然化合物的治疗剂被报道能抑制破骨细胞形成，并持续受到关注。苦杏仁苷（Amygdalin, AD）是从杏（Prunus armeniaca L.）种子中分离得到的，具有多种药理作用；然而，AD对破骨细胞形成和功能的影响仍不清楚。因此，本研究探讨了AD对RAW 264.7细胞中RANKL诱导的破骨细胞的潜在机制。分子对接模拟显示，AD能以负结合亲和力与RANKL的活性位点结合。通过TRAP活性、骨吸收和迁移实验，AD有效抑制了破骨细胞分化和功能。转录因子如NFATc1、c-fos以及骨特异性基因（包括dcstamp、acp5、ATP6v0d2和ctsk结果）的表达显示，AD处理具有抑制破骨细胞分化的效果。此外，在AD存在下，RANKL诱导的MAPK激活、内质网应激和ROS水平在RANKL诱导的破骨细胞中显著受到抑制，而抗氧化酶得到恢复。这些结果表明，AD可能是一种源自天然的潜在候选药物，用于治疗破骨细胞相关骨病。
